name: choose_item
text: A shopper points with the right hand at goods on the counter in front. Keeping the hand low, they indicate one item, then move the hand sideways to indicate another, and return the arm to their side. The left arm stays relaxed.

review.notes_zh: 前两版文字生成分别变成高位交谈手势和低头垂手；改用右手关键帧后，手到达柜台前缘附近并横向换指，随后收回。左臂放松、双脚稳定，已查完整手部。表示挑选方向，模型不支持单独伸直食指。首尾站姿一致。
